criterion_text: The Server/Agent session sizing owner applies or negotiates the configured fixed columns through the existing ControlLease/authorized resize path, including standalone mode, and prevents mismatched Web↔Server build settings or old attached clients from silently resizing live tmux Sessions.

verifiers.summary: The Agent owns and enforces the Session width through the ControlLease path, including standalone mode; mismatched clients cannot reflow a live Session

evidence.value: exact SHA ea22b0385a4cc41786dc5d884959eee48e9b5b00 on tmux 3.4: a real Agent created a new Session at the configured width, kept that width when a second client attached with a different width, and applied only the lease holder's rows on resize
an existing pane kept its width at attach and the reply stated it; the registry test proved the applied resize is the Session's columns with the requested rows
a standalone Agent (no Server in the path) used its own configured width for creation and stated it on attach
the Web attach-reply parser accepts the Agent-stated width and ignores malformed values, so a client from a different build adopts the Session rather than resizing it
